The [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Volfe Karkko]] was incarcerated in a '''temple''' on the [[Prison/Legends|prison]]-[[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Kiffex/Legends|Kiffex]] when he was [[Duel on Kiffex|apprehended]] by the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]] prior to the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]]. The temple was destroyed in [[30 BBY/Legends|30 BBY]] when [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Quinlan Vos/Legends|Quinlan Vos]] [[Mission to Kiffex|defeated]] Karkko and rescued his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Aayla Secura/Legends|Aayla Secura]], from the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi's]] influence.
